plastic_bottle.recommended_handling: Empty, rinse, and place in an appropriate plastic recycling stream.

plastic_bag.recommended_handling: Keep separate and use a designated soft-plastic collection point where available.

metal_can.recommended_handling: Empty, rinse, and place in an appropriate metal recycling stream.

cardboard.recommended_handling: Keep clean and dry, flatten, and place in a paper recycling stream.

paper.recommended_handling: Keep clean and dry and place in an appropriate paper recycling stream.

glass.recommended_handling: Separate carefully and place in a designated glass recycling container.

food_waste.recommended_handling: Keep separate from recyclables and use composting or an organic-waste stream where available.

general_waste.recommended_handling: Bag securely and place in the appropriate general-waste collection stream.

construction_debris.recommended_handling: Keep separate from household waste and arrange collection by an authorised construction-waste handler.

electronic_waste.recommended_handling: Keep dry and intact and deliver to an authorised electronic-waste collection facility.
